text: 2026-08-03 implementation: ResponsePreparation now applies declared fixed weights as sqrt(w) to selected design/response rows, supports full-model and selected-row index mapping, rejects zero/negative/non-finite weights with typed InvalidVolumeWeights, rejects estimated weighting during preparation with typed UnsupportedVolumeWeighting, and marks fixed/estimated provenance Applied/Rejected instead of silently Deferred. ResponsePreparationSuite passes 7/7 on JVM and JS. Remaining: carry weighting receipt through fit results/manifests, independent external WLS parity, chunked public-plan coverage, zero-row semantics if ever supported, and an explicit estimator for Estimated.
